name: Documenso
description: Modern Documenso v2 envelope API for documents and templates, files, recipients, fields, distribution, audit logs, folders, and embedded presign tokens. Supports Documenso Cloud and self-hosted installations. Team webhooks are configured in Documenso settings.

credential_fields.name: api_key
credential_fields.label: Documenso API Key
credential_fields.description: Documenso API keys are sent directly in Authorization, without the Bearer prefix.

credential_fields.name: base_url
credential_fields.label: V2 API Base URL
credential_fields.description: Use https://app.documenso.com/api/v2 for Documenso Cloud, or your self-hosted /api/v2 URL without a trailing slash.

tools.name: list_envelopes
tools.description: List document and template envelopes with pagination, type, status, folder, owner, and search filters.

tools.name: get_envelope
tools.description: Get an envelope with its items, recipients, fields, metadata, and status.

tools.name: get_envelopes
tools.description: Get multiple envelopes by ID in one request.

tools.name: create_envelope
tools.description: Create a DOCUMENT or TEMPLATE envelope and upload one or more source files in the same multipart call. payload is sent as JSON and files as repeated binary parts.

payload.description: Envelope metadata such as title, type (DOCUMENT or TEMPLATE), folderId, externalId, visibility, globalAccessAuth, and globalActionAuth.

files.description: One or more PDF/document values as base64, data URLs, or binary files.

tools.name: use_template_envelope
tools.description: Create a new document envelope from a TEMPLATE envelope, optionally overriding title, recipients, fields, and distribution settings.

tools.name: update_envelope
tools.description: Update envelope title, type-compatible settings, folder, visibility, authentication, metadata, or external ID.

tools.name: delete_envelope
tools.description: Permanently delete an envelope and its signing data.

tools.name: duplicate_envelope
tools.description: Duplicate a document or template envelope.

tools.name: distribute_envelope
tools.description: Send a draft envelope to its recipients. Configure recipients and fields first; the envelope must be distributable.

tools.name: redistribute_envelope
tools.description: Resend an already distributed envelope to pending recipients, optionally selecting recipient IDs.

tools.name: get_envelope_audit_log
tools.description: Get the immutable audit log for an envelope.

tools.name: create_envelope_items
tools.description: Attach one or more already-uploaded envelope items/documents to an envelope using the v2 item structure.

tools.name: update_envelope_items
tools.description: Update envelope item titles, ordering, and metadata.

tools.name: delete_envelope_item
tools.description: Delete one item/document from an envelope.

tools.name: download_envelope_item
tools.description: Download the source or completed PDF for one envelope item.

tools.name: get_recipient
tools.description: Get one envelope recipient and signing state.

tools.name: create_recipients
tools.description: Create recipients in an envelope. Each recipient specifies email, name, role, signingOrder, authentication, and optional redirect settings.

tools.name: update_recipients
tools.description: Update recipient identity, role, signing order, authentication, or delivery settings.

tools.name: delete_recipient
tools.description: Delete one recipient from a draft envelope.

tools.name: get_field
tools.description: Get one signing field and its recipient/item association.

tools.name: create_fields
tools.description: Create signing fields in bulk. Each field targets an envelope item/page and recipient with type, position, dimensions, and optional validation.

tools.name: update_fields
tools.description: Update signing fields in bulk using their field IDs.

tools.name: delete_field
tools.description: Delete one signing field from a draft envelope.

tools.name: list_folders
tools.description: List folders available to the current team.

tools.name: create_folder
tools.description: Create a document/template folder.

tools.name: update_folder
tools.description: Rename or move a folder.

tools.name: delete_folder
tools.description: Delete a folder. Move or delete contained envelopes first if required by the server.

tools.name: create_embedding_presign_token
tools.description: Create a short-lived presign token for Documenso embedded authoring/signing. Scope it to the intended envelope and embedding action.

tools.name: verify_embedding_presign_token
tools.description: Verify and inspect an embedding presign token before using it.
